episode_title: Podcast 121 | Association Member Experience Trends: Why People Join and Stay

real_qa.q: Why do association members join and stay according to Forge's State of Association Member Experience Report?
real_qa.r: Overwhelmingly across the last five years, the top two reasons why members join and stay are for peer-to-peer connections and for ongoing learning and the opportunity to participate in education. 85% of respondents cite one of those two as the primary reason.
real_qa.requete: why do association members join stay Forge report

real_qa.q: What percentage of association members believe AI could replace what associations provide?
real_qa.r: Only 1% of respondents cited that AI could replace what the association provides. This means 99% are saying what the association provides is irreplaceable, though trust in AI-generated content specifically dropped from 31% to 26% year over year.
real_qa.requete: AI replace association members Forge survey 2024

real_qa.q: What percentage of early-career professionals are switching careers when joining associations?
real_qa.r: 40% of individuals who identified as early career were actually switching careers, meaning they were early in that field but not young professionals. This dropped to 13% for mid-career and 10% for late career members.
real_qa.requete: early career switching careers association members percentage

real_qa.q: How does trust in AI-generated content change when validated by an expert in associations?
real_qa.r: When AI content is validated by an expert, trust goes up to 49%, compared to 26% for AI-generated content without expert validation. The opportunity for associations is to leverage AI but backstop it with their credible expertise.
real_qa.requete: expert validated AI content trust associations

real_qa.q: What are the six moments that matter most for association members outside annual events according to Forge?
real_qa.r: Through research, Forge identified six moments that matter most for members of associations outside their in-person annual event. Journey by Forge powers all interactions and education for those members year-round through a single solution combining community, learning and insights.
real_qa.requete: Forge six moments matter association members

guest.bio_context: Kurt Haken grew up in HR tech, serving talent and people leaders at major organizations including Procter and Gamble, Amazon, and Walmart. Six years ago, he founded Forge to bring a mission-driven approach to the association market, focusing on modernizing member experience through integrated community and learning solutions.

real_quote: Trust in AI generated content went down from 31 percent to 26 percent year over year. But when that content is validated by an expert, the trust goes up to 49 percent.
